u08-rem-close.resolution: Checked each flag against the Greek; none is a meaning error. Fragment headings (Ps 133,1.2; 134,1.2; 134,3.4; 135,16-22) are the edition's LXX lemmata. οὐδὲ γὰρ αὖ ἑτέρως ἀπώλοντο ἂν μὴ οὐκ εἰς πλήρωσιν ἥκοντες = 'they would not have perished otherwise, had they not come to the fullness', as rendered. θεοῦ δὲ θησαυρὸν τὸ … ἀθεώρητον καὶ ἄγνωστον εἶναι = the unseen and unknown origin of the winds is God's treasury (same predication). 'they considered the foreign souls a foreign land' is the Greek's own order (ἀλλοτρίαν γῆν ἡγοῦντο τὰς ἀλλοτρίας ψυχάς). καὶ φυλάττεσθαι … ἐκφέρειν τὰ θεῖα continues that indirect statement ('and took care not to bring out the divine things among them'). The rest are particles, voice and aspect style.

u08-rem-close.resolution: Not meaning errors. 'the likeness of souls' keeps τῶν ψυχῶν. φιλάνθρωπον is rendered 'loving' (the gift toward these was loving), and τῆς φιλανθρωπίας is 'that love', referring back to it. φυλάττεσθαι … ἐκφέρειν τὰ θεῖα = 'to guard against bringing out the divine things' (middle φυλάττεσθαι + infinitive = take care not to), as rendered.
